description: Source code for EffectsFactory handling effect loading, enumeration, creation, and management in Android audio effects framework.

methods.name: Effect_Process
methods.description: Processes audio buffer through the effect.

methods.name: Effect_Command
methods.description: Sends a command to the effect.

methods.name: Effect_GetDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor of the effect.

methods.name: Effect_ProcessReverse
methods.description: Processes audio buffer in reverse if supported.

methods.name: EffectQueryNumberEffects
methods.description: Returns the total number of effects available.

methods.name: EffectQueryEffect
methods.description: Retrieves the effect descriptor at a given index.

methods.name: EffectGetDescriptor
methods.description: Finds and copies effect descriptor by UUID.

methods.name: EffectCreate
methods.description: Creates an effect instance by UUID.

methods.name: EffectIsNullUuid
methods.description: Checks if a UUID is null.
